summary: Take care of your very own Baby Unicorns in this Baby Care Dress Up Game!
description:
Do you love Unicorns? Do you love taking care of babies? Do you love Dress-up Games? Then you will love my My Baby Unicorn Pet! 

My Baby Unicorn lets you take care of Baby Unicorn Pets in this fascinating Baby Care Pet Simulator!

Take care of Baby Unicorn and a Bonus Baby Panda in a set of fun mini-games that will delight the whole family!

Become a babysitter and feed, bathe and dress up your pets! 

Start your day off with breakfast! Feed your pets some yummy breakfast treats like Rainbow Cereal, Watermelon, Donuts, Candy and more!

Let's try potty training your Unicorn pet! Hand them the newspaper while they sit on the toilet to go poop! Once they're done, flush and wash hands for good hygiene!

Let's head over to the beach, and play a fun game of ball, sand castles, guitar and drums! Toot the horn, and play a set of mini-games to have a fun break on the beach!

Let's stop off at the Supermarket with Mommy to pick up some delicious treats! Shop for cakes, cookies, milk, and even pick up some toys!

Head home and straight into a warm, bubbly bath! Play with bath toys, scrub with bubbles, and finish off with a good rinse!

It's been a long day and it's time for bed! Play a magical lullaby song and watch your Baby Panda & Unicorn drift off to sleep for a dreamy night!

Wake up and start the day again!

Baby Unicorn is tons of fun for the entire family, and is a polished game full of entertaining sounds and music that will delight players of all ages!
